 (let* ((turn-pattern #f)
        (bg (mode g -1))
        (foreground (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
                      (lambda (r c) (if (= (at g r c) bg) 0 1))))
        (components (objects foreground 0))
        (board-object (argmax (lambda (o) (* (obj-h o) (obj-w o))) components))
        (board-box (obj-bbox board-object))
        (board (crop g (first board-box) (second board-box)
                       (third board-box) (fourth board-box)))
        (loose (filter (lambda (o) (not (equal? o board-object))) components))
        (hole-count
          (lambda (patch)
            (length (objects (grid-from-fn (rows patch) (cols patch)
                               (lambda (r c) (if (= (at patch r c) bg) 1 0))) 0))))
        (patterns (map (lambda (o)
                         (let* ((box (obj-bbox o))
                                (patch (crop g (first box) (second box) (third box) (fourth box))))
                           (list (hole-count patch) patch box))) loose))
        (n (rows (second (first patterns))))
        (side (+ n 2))
        (matches
          (for*/list ((r (in-range 0 (rows board) side))
                      (c (in-range 0 (cols board) side)))
            (let* ((tile (crop board r c (+ r side -1) (+ c side -1)))
                   (clue (hole-count tile))
                   (pattern (first (filter (lambda (p) (= (first p) clue)) patterns))))
              (list r c (at tile 0 0) clue (second pattern) (third pattern))))))
   (for/fold ((out (grid-from-fn (rows board) (cols board) (lambda (r c) bg)))) ((match (in-list matches)))
     (let* ((r0 (first match)) (c0 (second match)) (base (third match))
            (patch (if turn-pattern (rotate-cw (fifth match)) (fifth match))))
       (for*/fold ((next out)) ((r (in-range side)) (c (in-range side)))
         (set-cell next (+ r0 r) (+ c0 c)
           (if (and (< 0 r (- side 1)) (< 0 c (- side 1))
                    (not (= (at patch (- r 1) (- c 1)) bg)))
               (at patch (- r 1) (- c 1)) base)))))))

(rule!
 ;; Background is the unique modal color, including zero as a possible foreground.
 ;; The largest square objects tile a panel; detached S-2 squares are templates.
 ;; Match using component count; component connectivity is four, not eight.
 ;; Inset the selected pattern by one cell and replace its background with tile color.
 ;; Erase the original clues and return only the completed panel's bounding rectangle.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define all (objects g bg))
   (define size (apply max (map obj-h all)))
   (define tiles (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-h o) size) (= (obj-w o) size))) all))
   (define templates (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-h o) (- size 2)) (= (obj-w o) (- size 2)))) all))
   (define (crop o) (subgrid g (obj-r1 o) (obj-c1 o) (obj-r2 o) (obj-c2 o)))
   (define (measure o) (length (objects (crop o) (obj-color o))))
   (define (before? a b) (or (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b)) (and (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b)) (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b)))))
   (define box (bbox-of-cells (apply append (map obj-cells tiles))))
   (define blank (empty-grid (+ 1 (- (third box) (first box))) (+ 1 (- (fourth box) (second box))) bg))
   (for/fold ((out blank)) ((tile tiles))
    (let* ((chosen (let ((found (filter (lambda (o) (= (measure o) (measure tile))) templates)))
          (first found)))
           (pattern (crop chosen)))
     (for*/fold ((a out)) ((r (range size)) (c (range size)))
      (let ((value (if (and (> r 0) (< r (- size 1)) (> c 0) (< c (- size 1)))
                      (let ((v (at pattern (- r 1) (- c 1)))) (if (= v bg) (obj-color tile) v))
                      (obj-color tile))))
       (set-cell a (+ (- (obj-r1 tile) (first box)) r) (+ (- (obj-c1 tile) (second box)) c) value))))))))
